status: DECLARED, not run; the prereg binding this file is unsigned until the coordinator signs it

excluded.2025-12-11: IEX side not in the holdout registry
excluded.2026-06-12: IEX side not in the holdout registry

calibration.n_shares_rule: per symbol: total traded shares (displayed and hidden, both venues) over the calibrate sessions / (sessions x 390), rounded to the nearest 100, at least 100 (about one row per minute)
calibration.threshold_rule: per symbol, signal and window: the 0.8 quantile of |signal| over the calibrate rows (rows with a value only)
calibration.reads: rows and signals only; no label, fill or P&L is computed on the calibrate sessions

window_rule: window = horizon (ofi_1m with h = 1 m, ofi_5m with h = 5 m)
target: spread-netted label sign(signal) * gross_h - cost_h (bps); taker and maker P&L in USD as the decision unit

statistics.unit: per-session net USD per cell (use x signal x horizon x symbol), sessions without trips at 0
statistics.family: 2 uses x 3 signals x 2 horizons x 2 symbols

per_cell.reject: family CI upper bound < 0, or the family CI contains 0 and the family MDE <= economic_threshold_usd
per_cell.underpowered: the family CI contains 0 and the family MDE > economic_threshold_usd, or no interval

per_use.candidate: some (signal, horizon) is candidate on both symbols
per_use.iterate: some cell is candidate, none on both symbols

decision_rule.missed_opportunity: reported per cell beside the P&L, never inside it
decision_rule.promotion: none in v1.18 (no untouched confirmation sample)

small_g: inference rests on G = 4 evaluate session clusters (3 df); at G <= 5 the result is a size statement, not a power statement, and no generalisation beyond these sessions is claimed
